airplay.airplay_daemon: The hub runs as a system daemon; Pandora Sync needs the logged-in user's session.
airplay.airplay_needs_output: Pandora Sync needs at least one AirPlay output.
airplay.airplay_no_match: No AirPlay outputs match {rooms}. Rename them to match in the Music app on the hub Mac, or choose outputs there.
airplay.airplay_nothing_to_restore: Pandora Sync ended; the Mac's outputs were left as they are.
airplay.airplay_off: Pandora Sync is turned off on this hub.
airplay.airplay_restore_failed: Pandora Sync ended, but the Mac's outputs could not be restored.
airplay.airplay_unavailable: Pandora Sync isn't available on the hub right now: {reason}
airplay.pandora_sync_outputs_only: Pandora Sync set the AirPlay outputs. Open pandora.com on the hub Mac and press play there.
airplay.pandora_sync_started: Pandora opened on the hub Mac. Press play there; the rooms follow.
airplay.pandora_sync_stopped: Pandora Sync ended; the Mac's outputs are back to how they were.

not_available.auth_fault: {side} can't reach {service} right now; sign in again in the {vendor_app}.
not_available.not_in_account: That station isn't in the {vendor} {service} account, so {side} can't play it.
not_available.not_linked: {side} can't play {service}; link it in the {vendor_app}.

templates.pandora_concurrent: Pandora usually allows one stream per account; the other room may pause.
templates.sync_unsupported_content: Sync Play works with Tidal content.
